logistics/knight/northgate-freight/1.headline: Northgate Freight
logistics/knight/northgate-freight/1.subheadline: Sea freight, air freight, customs clearance and bonded warehousing in Sampleton.
logistics/knight/northgate-freight/1.about: Northgate Freight is a freight company based at Unit 4, Dockside Park, Sampleton. Ruth Adeyemi has run it since 1992. We work from Sampleton Port to Northern Europe and the Far East. Our depot has a 24-hour container yard. We are a member of the Sampleton Freight Association and hold Fictionland Customs Agent Licence No. 4471.

issues.line: The UK's leading forwarder, trusted by 500+ shippers with a 100% on-time record.
issues.problem: Uses the forbidden words "leading", "trusted by", "100%" and "on-time record". "500+ shippers" is a customer count that is not in the facts. "UK" is a country the facts do not mention. The line is an unsupported superlative and track-record claim.

logistics/sender/first-email/northgate-f.subject: A website concept for Northgate Freight
logistics/sender/first-email/northgate-f.body:
Hi Ruth Adeyemi,

I looked at the Northgate Freight website and put together a free concept of a modern version, using only the details already on your site:

{concept_url}

A few things the current site is missing:
• The site isn't set up for phones, so pages can look tiny or hard to read for customers browsing on mobile.
• The phone number can't be tapped to call, so mobile visitors have to copy or write it down instead of reaching you in one touch.
• There's no clear page title or description for Google, so your business may appear as a vague or unhelpful listing in search results.
• There's no online booking or reservation link, so customers who are ready to get in touch have no quick way to do it.

If it's useful, we can build the real site for $500. No obligation; just reply if you'd like to talk it through.

Alex

logistics/knight/harbourline-customs/1.about: Harbourline Customs is a customs agent in Sampleton, run by Viktor Lindqvist since 2006. We work with cargo through Sampleton Port and Sampleton Airport.
